label: Late in episodes, rises after unrewarded trials at D1 and with S1-favoring belief or a1 choice.
terms: (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_common == 0) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_action == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; belief_lo * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * ep_dec ;; (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 9 decays strongly over the episode (timing R^2 0.87); the history effects beyond timing grow with episode decile, so every term is scaled by ep_dec. At D1 it is higher after an unrewarded trial (reward input 0) and lower after reward, especially rare-rewarded trials. At GO/D2 it tracks an S1/a1 side: higher when the observer belief favours S1 (belief_lo) and when the last action input is a1 (previous choice at GO, this trial choice at D2), lower after an unrewarded S1 outcome. Short form (reward at D1, belief, a1 action input, all times episode decile) reaches dev R^2 0.42 beyond timing vs 0.51 for the 8-term free fit, which adds rare-rewarded at D1, prev S1 unrewarded at GO/D2, the reached state at D2 and the reward two trials back. Only observed variables are used. Remaining misses: long runs of rewarded trials late in the episode drive it more negative than predicted (a cumulative reward effect).
